_meta.purpose: GroundedReview E1 cross-model external validation candidate profiles. Offline preparation only; NO paid call is authorised by the existence of this file.
_meta.frozen_protocol: p3-ternary-v2, 22 fixtures x 5 conditions = 110 cells/model, one fresh session per cell
_meta.wave21_subject: deepseek-flash (frozen baseline; results reused, never re-run in E1)

excluded.gpt-5-mini: deprecated 2026-06-11, scheduled retirement 2026-12-11; reproducibility risk for a frozen-protocol replication

adaptation_contract.completion_param: name of the hard output-cap parameter the vendor accepts
adaptation_contract.temperature_supported: if false, adapter drops the frozen temperature=0
adaptation_contract.extra_body: vendor-specific passthrough that REPLACES the frozen runner's DeepSeek-only {'thinking':{'type':'disabled'}} body (other vendors reject that unknown field)
adaptation_contract.response_format: json_schema_strict | json_object | plain_text; adapter downgrades the frozen strict schema accordingly, and RecordingCompletions adds a runtime json_schema->json_object->plain_text fallback on 400
adaptation_contract.note: task semantics, prompts, tools, tool permissions and JSON decision keys are unchanged; only API-wire parameters are adapted

openai_gpt41_mini.reasoning: none (non-reasoning chat model; no hidden reasoning tokens)

response_format_change_history.reason: Smoke (2026-10-22) showed OpenAI returns deterministic 400 for the frozen TERNARY_DECISION_SCHEMA because it declares 4 properties but lists only 3 in required (missing_evidence omitted); OpenAI strict Structured Outputs require every property in required. User-authorized API-compatibility-only fix (2026-10-23): change ONLY this adapter wire parameter; frozen prompt/gold/decision schema/tools/scoring/ternary parser (incl. INVALID/AMBIGUOUS) are unchanged. json_object guarantees valid JSON, not schema conformance, so non-conforming JSON is still caught by the existing parser and counted as INVALID/AMBIGUOUS exactly as before. Distinct protocol version from the strict-schema smoke cells, which are excluded from the 110-cell primary results.

openai_gpt41_mini.e1_role: non-reasoning cross-provider CONTROL for this single E1 replication only; NOT a long-term sole external baseline - newer current models join the multi-model benchmark later (user decision 2026-10-21)
openai_gpt41_mini.selection_rationale: Different vendor from DeepSeek; closest wire-level match to the frozen runner (temperature, max_tokens, strict JSON schema, native parallel tool calls), so observed differences are least likely to come from interface configuration. Deprecation (retire 2027-01-14) does not block E1 but rules it out as a durable sole baseline.

google_gemini3_flash.reasoning: thinking model; OpenAI-compatibility reasoning controls differ across releases and MUST be smoke-tested before any paid run
google_gemini3_flash.selection_rationale: Second independent vendor via the documented OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Strict-schema and multi-turn tool-call behaviour on the compatibility layer is the main interface risk; adapter pre-downgrades to json_object and a fixture-level live smoke (2 cells) is required before the full run.
known_risks: compatibility-layer strict json_schema support has historically been incomplete
thinking tokens are billed inside output tokens; real cost may exceed the wave21-token-based estimate
preview model id can be retired across Gemini minor releases

openai_gpt51_codex_mini.reasoning: reasoning coding model; reasoning tokens are billed as output and counted in max_completion_tokens
openai_gpt51_codex_mini.estimated_cost_110_cells_usd_note: wave21-token proxy ~$0.65 before reasoning-token inflation; output multiplier is the dominant uncertainty, BudgetGuard pre-call bound still caps spend
openai_gpt51_codex_mini.selection_rationale: Code-review-tuned third candidate exercising the max_completion_tokens / no-temperature / reasoning_effort adaptation path. Only if the user wants a second OpenAI-family point; gpt-4.1-mini remains the controlled primary.
